# WideScope — LLM Trace Viewer

> A browser-native, zero-backend trace viewer for LLM and AI agent pipelines. 
> Load OTLP, Jaeger, or OpenInference JSON traces and inspect them instantly — 
> all data stays in your browser. Powered by Rust/WASM and Svelte.

## Pages

- [WideScope](https://widescope.soumendrak.com) — Landing page with product overview.
- [WideScope editor](https://widescope.soumendrak.com/editor/) — The trace viewer. Drag-and-drop trace JSON, inspect spans, timelines, flame graphs, LLM calls, and costs.
- [Get a trace file](https://widescope.soumendrak.com/docs/) — Copy-paste recipes to export an OTLP/Jaeger/OpenInference JSON trace from the OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, LangChain/LangGraph, or a generic OpenTelemetry collector.

## Features

- LLM-aware inspection with model, token, prompt/completion, and tool-call detail views
- Five trace views: flame graph, timeline, waterfall, service dependency graph, trace diff
- Privacy-first: no upload, no backend, no telemetry — traces never leave your browser
- Shareable links with DEFLATE-compressed self-contained trace embedding
- Multi-trace loading via zip upload, file picker, clipboard paste, or JSON editor
- Attribute search with operators (`duration>100ms`, `status=error`)
- Span filtering, annotations, trace slicing, and latency heatmap
- Embed mode for external tool integration

## Supported formats

- OTLP JSON (`resourceSpans`)
- Jaeger JSON (`data[].spans`)  
- OpenInference JSON (`spans`)
